in_marathi.name: Hanamanth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hanamanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hanamanth is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Hana' which means 'grace' and 'Mantha' which means 'man'. This name signifies the divine grace bestowed upon an individual by the gods.
